✅ QA TEST PLAN – Aplicación de Alerta de Ubicación

🎯 Objective

Verify functional correctness, usability, performance, and reliability of the location-based alert mobile application. This plan ensures that features behave as expected across different usage scenarios, devices, and conditions.


---

📂 Test Categories

🔹 1. Functional Testing

Test Case ID	Test Case Description	Steps to Reproduce	Expected Result	Priority

TC-F001	Set current location	Tap Set Actual Location with GPS enabled	Coordinates are displayed in the textbox below the button	High
TC-F002	Set location without GPS	Turn off GPS, then tap the button	App displays a toast/message prompting to enable GPS	High
TC-F003	Set location with no permissions granted	Deny location permission and tap button	App displays permission request or error message	High
TC-F004	Lock icon unlocks map and slider	Tap on the lock image	Map and slider become visible/active	High
TC-F005	Slider updates distance label	Slide to different values	Label updates with correct meter value (e.g., 500m, 750m)	Medium
TC-F006	Set destination on map	Tap on a location on the map (after unlocked)	Destination is set, and marked with a pin	High
TC-F007	Alert on proximity	Walk/drive towards destination within selected range	Audible/vibration alert is triggered	High
TC-F008	Cancel destination	Press back or “Clear Destination”	Destination and alert are cleared	Medium



---

🔹 2. UI/UX Testing

Test Case ID	Description	Expected Result	Priority

TC-UI001	All buttons visible on small screens	All elements render without overlapping	High
TC-UI002	Button labels and icons are self-explanatory	User understands each control without needing the manual	Medium
TC-UI003	Lock icon has tooltip or label	Tooltip appears on long-press or below the icon	Medium
TC-UI004	Text and icons scale with system font size	Proper scaling on accessibility settings	Medium
TC-UI005	Proper contrast between elements	Text and controls meet WCAG contrast standards	Medium



---

🔹 3. Edge Case & Negative Testing

Test Case ID	Description	Steps	Expected Result	Priority

TC-E001	GPS signal lost after setting destination	Start movement and disable GPS	App notifies user and pauses tracking	High
TC-E002	Slider set to 0m	Move slider to 0	App shows warning or disallows alert with 0m	Medium
TC-E003	Location API error	Simulate mock location failure	App handles gracefully and shows error	High
TC-E004	Simultaneous unlock + slider movement	Tap lock and quickly drag slider	No crash or inconsistency	Medium



---

🔹 4. Performance Testing

Test Case ID	Description	Expected Result	Priority

TC-P001	App performance with poor GPS signal	App handles slow GPS update gracefully	High
TC-P002	Memory usage after long session	App does not leak memory or crash	Medium
TC-P003	Power consumption	App does not excessively drain battery	Medium



---

🔹 5. Compatibility Testing

Test Case ID	Description	Devices/Conditions	Expected Result	Priority

TC-C001	Android 8–14	Multiple Android versions	App works correctly	High
TC-C002	Screen size: phone vs tablet	Various screen sizes and DPI	Responsive layout	High
TC-C003	Dark mode support	System dark mode enabled	UI adapts properly	Medium



---

🧪 Automation Suggestions

Use Appium with Python or Espresso (Android) for:

Button tap simulation

GPS mocking

UI flow validation

Slider interaction test

Background and foreground transitions



---

🔍 Refined UI/UX Critique

🔹 Visual Issues

Element	Issue	Suggestion

Button Set Actual Location	Unclear purpose without context	Add label above: “Presiona para establecer tu ubicación actual”
Image Icon (Lock)	Not intuitive, no label	Add a tooltip or inline text: “Desbloquear destino y distancia”
Text fields	No labels or placeholders	Use meaningful placeholders like “Coordenadas actuales”
Slider	Poor contrast, no real-time feedback	Add value label (e.g., 500m) dynamically updating
Font consistency	Unclear sizes, spacing	Use material design typography for hierarchy and readability



---

🔹 Functional Usability

Area	Concern	Recommendation

Feedback on action	No confirmation for location set or unlock	Show Toast/Snackbar confirming actions
Error handling	Not specified in UI	Visual indication of errors (e.g., red highlight, toast)
App State	No indication of whether map/distance is set	Use color/indicator to show app state (e.g., "Tracking Active")



---

🔹 Accessibility & Inclusiveness

Add content descriptions for all icons for screen readers.

Ensure UI components are navigable via keyboard or switch input (for accessibility settings).

Enable high-contrast mode compatibility.



---

🎯 Final Recommendations

✅ Group components: Group coordinate-related inputs together with proper spacing.

✅ Onboarding/Help: Include a help screen or onboarding popup for first-time users.

✅ Design polish: Use consistent material design elements for professionalism.

✅ Localization: Make the app multilingual-ready from the start.
